terra.problem: “Joseph Sold to Egypt” begins with a sale outside Egypt; only the later sale to Potiphar happens in Egypt. Also, Genesis 37:25–28 does not include the sale to Potiphar; add verse 36 to the passage.
“God Sends Jacob to Egypt” describes God speaking to Jacob at Beersheba, before Jacob reaches Egypt. The moment ends with Jacob’s family going to Egypt, but the conversation does not happen there.
“Every firstborn in Egypt” is too broad. Exodus 12:29 specifies firstborn males, as well as the firstborn of the livestock; the Israelites were protected by the Passover.
“Offspring” may be unfamiliar at a 5th-grade reading level. Consider “family” or “descendants.”
